aggregateScope.qualityAggregation: mean of subtask means within each category, then unweighted mean of all complete categories
aggregateScope.costAggregation: sum subtask total costs divided by sum subtask question counts
aggregateScope.comparableEligibility: complete scores/costs/counts and identical full subtask count vector; modal complete count vector across cost rows; positive reported mean cost for priced frontier; no score-based pool selection
aggregateScope.zeroCostPolicy: preserve reported 0, flag separately as unverified free access, exclude from priced frontier
aggregateScope.numericPolicy: compensated means; frontier pair tolerance quality=32*EPSILON*max(1,absQa,absQb), cost=32*EPSILON*max(absCa,absCb); strict improvement exceeds tolerance, no display rounding
aggregateScope.allowedConclusion: descriptive static-model quality-cost profile under author aggregate cost accounting

futureQuestionExperiment.status: planned-not-executed; finalize metadata eligibility before test outcomes
futureQuestionExperiment.quality: bounded continuous score in [0,1]; never Boolean(score)
futureQuestionExperiment.duplicates: whole normalized-query/source-family groups; cross-domain duplicates first merged into one canonical domain

split.method: SHA256('dsh-livebench-v1:' + groupId) first 8 hex digits modulo 100

futureQuestionExperiment.replay: first-stage-model direct-answer projection, not production DAG replay
futureQuestionExperiment.supplementalCohort: both frozen routers have exactly one execution node; query-only eligibility and coverage reported
futureQuestionExperiment.profiles: train only; same profile inputs for old/current; no external leaderboard refresh
futureQuestionExperiment.selectionIntegrity: write and hash choices before joining test outcomes; permutation/cost-multiplication invariance test required
futureQuestionExperiment.qualityMetric: micro mean bounded quality; macro/domain supplemental
futureQuestionExperiment.costMetric: mean consistently accounted question cost including strategy overhead; nominal estimates labeled as such
futureQuestionExperiment.bootstrap: paired domain-stratified whole-group percentile; fixed groups per domain, variable sampled rows; micro/cost sampled-row weighted, macro domain-equal; approximate not finite-sample certification
futureQuestionExperiment.benefitRule: quality lower percentile at alpha/(2K) >= -margin AND cost upper percentile at 1-alpha/(2K) < 0
futureQuestionExperiment.numericGuards: also require compensated quality+margin lower >=0 and cost upper < -32*Number.EPSILON*max(original mean costs); no widened business margin or fixed USD floor
futureQuestionExperiment.missingPolicy: missing quality/cost not zero; frozen eligibility and exclusions reported; no outcome-conditioned row dropping
futureQuestionExperiment.costRepricing: current prices, if used, are separate counterfactual estimates, never actual historical invoice savings
